Kinoko is serving at http://localhost:4123/. Kinoko is a code database. You change code by staging a patch that either PROMOTES (the whole committed image still typechecks) or stays staged with the exact reasons it cannot. Small patches read for their reasons are the fast path. CALL `guide` BEFORE YOUR FIRST PATCH: your client may cut these instructions short, and it holds the rest: a whole app with every declaration form, events and forms, stored data, and the whole stdlib. Code lives in UNIVERSES (named code databases). Every tool but `list_universes`, `create_universe`, `list_deployments` and `guide` takes an optional `universe` (default "main", which is shared). The language is Yabu: defmodel / deftype / def / deftest / defapp / defroutes. An app is one Elm-style loop: init() -> (Model, Cmd), update(msg, model) -> (Model, Cmd), view(model) -> Html, JSX styled by Tailwind. THE SYNTAX YOU CANNOT GUESS (Elixir-flavoured, not ML or JS) %App.Model{count: 1, name: "x"} construct; NO Model(...), .new or .create %App.Model{row | count: 2} update a copy; there is no assignment %{"k" => v} [1, 2] map and list literals case msg do App.Msg.Add(n) -> ... end match (`do`, never `of`) if c do a else b end an expression; else is required fn (x : Int) -> x + 1 end lambda not a / a and b / a or b booleans; no `!`, `&&` or `||` x = e binds ONE name; no `(a, b) = e` case t do (m, cmd) -> m end take a tuple apart; there is no `t.0` Option.Some(x) / Option.None variants are qualified too deftest App.adds do always(App.add(1, 2) == 3) end Every name is fully qualified everywhere: `App.helper(x)`, never `helper(x)`. Construction lists EVERY field (no defaults); `{row | f: v}` copies the rest. A pattern is `_`, a lowercase name, an Int, String, true or false, a tuple or a variant. NO list patterns (`[]`, `[x | rest]`): use `case List.head(xs) do Option.Some(x) -> ... Option.None -> ... end`. There is no List.find: `List.head(List.filter(xs, fn (x : T) -> ... end))`. `defapp App` is a bare declaration: no `do` block, no options. It needs App.Model, App.Msg, App.init, App.update and App.view. Events: on-click, on-blur, on-focus, on-keydown, on-keyup and on-submit (on a
) take a message VALUE. Text comes in only through on-change on an input, textarea or select: an unapplied constructor of one String (`on-change={App.Msg.SetTitle}`), sent with the text on every edit. Any other on-* (on-input too) is refused. A case arm's body is ONE expression: no `x = e` in it (bind before the case, or call a helper). Annotations name concrete types, never a type variable: a shared view helper returns `Html`, not `Html`. THE LOOP 1. Look first: `symbols`, then `read` what you will touch. 2. `stage_patch` with a patch id and source (`remove` deletes symbols). 3. `promoted: ids` is committed. `staged: id` is NOT success: fix each `- symbol [code] message` reason and restage THE SAME id. 4. Prove it: `eval` an expression (`value : type`), `test` a deftest. SERVING YOUR APP `defroutes Main` is served at http://localhost:4123/ by the built-in `local` deployment. To give an app its own address, give it a route table: defroutes Counter.Routes do "/" -> Counter end and call `create_deployment` (name "counter", routes "Counter.Routes"): it serves at http://counter.localhost:4123/ and follows the universe's head, so every promotion is live at once. `list_deployments` shows them all. There is no other way to make a deployment. DECLARATIONS: one whole app, every form you need (it promotes as written) defmodel Counter.Snapshot do id : Uuid count : Int label : String saves : Int = 1 end defmodel Counter.Model do count : Int label : String snapshots : List end deftype Counter.Msg do Increment | Add(Int) | Rename(String) | Save | Saved(Uuid) | Loaded(List) | Again(Uuid) | Done(Result<(List, Int), String>) end def Counter.init() : (Counter.Model, Cmd) do (%Counter.Model{count: 0, label: "clicks", snapshots: []}, Cmd.store.list(Counter.Msg.Loaded)) end def Counter.again(id : Uuid) : Cmd do Cmd.store.tx( fn (s : Store) -> case Store.get(s, id) do Option.Some(snap) -> ([Tx.update(id, %Counter.Snapshot{snap | saves: snap.saves + 1})], snap.saves + 1) Option.None -> ([], 0) end end, Counter.Msg.Done ) end def Counter.update(msg : Counter.Msg, model : Counter.Model) : (Counter.Model, Cmd) do case msg do Counter.Msg.Increment -> (%Counter.Model{model | count: model.count + 1}, Cmd.none()) Counter.Msg.Add(n) -> if model.count + n >= 0 do (%Counter.Model{model | count: model.count + n}, Cmd.none()) else (model, Cmd.none()) end Counter.Msg.Rename(s) -> (%Counter.Model{model | label: s}, Cmd.none()) Counter.Msg.Save -> (model, Cmd.store.insert(%Counter.Snapshot{count: model.count, label: model.label, saves: 1}, Counter.Msg.Saved)) Counter.Msg.Saved(id) -> (model, Cmd.store.list(Counter.Msg.Loaded)) Counter.Msg.Loaded(rows) -> (%Counter.Model{model | snapshots: rows}, Cmd.none()) Counter.Msg.Again(id) -> (model, Counter.again(id)) Counter.Msg.Done(result) -> (model, Cmd.store.list(Counter.Msg.Loaded)) end end def Counter.view(model : Counter.Model) : Html do shown = String.concat(String.concat(model.label, ": "), String.from_int(model.count))
{shown}

    • end)}
end defapp Counter defroutes Main do "/" -> Counter end - defmodel: one `field : Type` per line, optionally `= ` (a default; see STORED DATA). deftype: variants separated by `|`, a payload in parentheses, `Counter.Msg.Add(Int)`. - def: every parameter and the return type annotated; the body's last expression is the value. `next = expr` binds a local (no reassignment). - case arms are `Pattern -> expr`, one per line, and must cover every variant. - JSX: attributes are strings or `{expr}`; `{expr}` in a body renders its value. Any on-* other than the events above is refused. A text input and a submit button: def Counter.form(model : Counter.Model) : Html do end - `defapp Counter` names an app; its name ends in a capitalized segment, and it needs Counter.Model (a defmodel), Counter.Msg (a deftype) and exactly `Counter.init() : (Counter.Model, Cmd)`, `Counter.update(msg : Counter.Msg, model : Counter.Model) : (Counter.Model, Cmd)`, `Counter.view(model : Counter.Model) : Html`. - defroutes maps URL paths to apps; a deployment serves one route table. `:name` captures a segment and is passed to the app's `init` as a parameter, typed Int, String or Uuid: `"/post/:id" -> Forum.Post` needs `def Forum.Post.init(id : Uuid) : (Forum.Post.Model, Cmd)` (the init's parameter names are exactly the pattern's params, as a set; the URL fills them by name). A URL that does not parse as its type is a 404. - Cmd.navigate(App, args...) goes to the route that opens App with those args: `Cmd.navigate(Forum.Post, topic.id)` from update, `Cmd.navigate(Forum.Settings)` when it takes none. Promotion checks that the target is an app and the args fit its init; whether a route reaches it is checked at run time, by the deployment serving the page (with none, the page shows an error). - `list_staged` shows every staged patch, its reasons and source; `unstage` drops one. `history` shows what promoted, and when. WHAT COSTS THE MOST REWORK - A patch replaces the declarations it names WHOLE. `read` before modifying, or you will silently drop fields, variants or branches you did not restate. - Symbols that change together must be in ONE patch: a patch that breaks a committed dependent cannot promote. - A Model field holds data: Int, String, Bool, Uuid, Unit, List, Map, Option, tuples, another defmodel, or your own deftype (its payloads data too). Never a function, Cmd or Html. - Construction has NO defaults: `%App.Model{...}` must list EVERY field (a missing one is `missing-field`). `%App.Model{row | f: v}` copies the rest, so add a field and you must add it to every construction. - always(...) is checked when it runs: an `eval` that reaches it, or a `test`. Nothing explores states for you, so drive update through the cases that matter (init's model included) with eval, or write a deftest. - `eval` and `test` see only committed code: a staged patch is invisible until it promotes. - A universe can be DEGRADED: its committed code stopped typechecking (the checker changed under it). `symbols` and `list_universes` say so and `health` lists why; eval and test answer `[degraded]` until a patch that fixes every listed reason promotes (it must make the whole image check). Code with an on-* event the page never wired (on-input, say) now degrades this way: move it to a supported event. - Cmd values (effects) are data to `eval`: it shows the Cmd a function returns and runs nothing. A deployment serving the app runs them (Cmd.store.*, Cmd.time.now in Unix milliseconds, Cmd.random.int, Cmd.navigate); Cmd.blob.* and Cmd.ai.* are not available yet. STORED DATA (Cmd.store.*): the Model is session state and is gone on reload; durable rows go to the store. Each DEPLOYMENT has its own data (staging and prod never share rows), whatever commit it serves. - A STORED model is a defmodel with `id : Uuid`. Only stored models go through Cmd.store.* or Tx (else `not-stored`). Never write `id`: construction omits it (`%Counter.Snapshot{count: 1, label: "x", saves: 1}`), insert mints it, and every row read back carries a real one. - A stored model's fields may hold any data: scalars, List, Map, Option, tuples, nested models, your own deftype and Result too. Every one is stored and read back exactly. - Cmd.store.insert(row, fn (id : Uuid) -> msg end) Cmd.store.list(fn (rows : List) -> msg end) insertion order, max 10000 Cmd.store.get(id, fn (row : Option) -> msg end) Cmd.store.update(id, row, fn (id : Uuid) -> msg end) whole-row replace Cmd.store.delete(id, fn (row : Option) -> msg end) The model M comes from the row (insert, update) or from the callback's type (list, get, delete), so pass a Msg constructor (`Cmd.store.list(Counter.Msg.Loaded)` with `Loaded(List)`). A failed operation shows the page's error banner and sends no msg. - Read-modify-write is a TRANSACTION closure, run atomically (concurrent ones never lose an update): Cmd.store.tx(fn (s : Store) -> (List, r) end, fn (result : Result<(List, r), String>) -> msg end) Inside it, read with Store.get(s, id) : Option and Store.list(s) : List (annotate when nothing else fixes M: `(Store.list(s) : List)`), and return the writes as ops: Tx.insert(row), Tx.update(id, row), Tx.delete(App.Row, id). They apply in order after the body returns (the body reads the data as it was before them); the callback gets Ok((inserted ids, r)) or Err(message), and on Err nothing was written. See Counter.again above. - Defaults: `saves : Int = 1`. A default is a constant (literal, list, map, tuple, variant of constants) of the field's type. It only fills in rows stored before the field existed; construction still lists EVERY field. An Option field takes no default (absent reads as Option.None). - Evolution is ADD-ONLY, checked at promotion (`model-evolution`), for a stored model and for every model stored inside one (a field's List, Option, Map, tuple or nested model): a field never changes type and is never removed (leave it, unused), and a new field must be Option or have a default. Changing a default is fine. A deftype stored inside one keeps every variant with exactly its payload and may only gain variants. Old code (a deployment pinned to an older commit) still reads rows newer code wrote; the newer fields are ignored. If what you need is not listed, write it as your own def (fully qualified, in your patch) and say so rather than inventing a function.

content.text:
The forum is live at **http://forum.localhost:4123/** in Kinoko's `main` universe. It updates automatically every time new code is committed.

**What it does:**
- **Home page (`/`):** a form to start a new thread (title, message, and an optional name that defaults to "anonymous"). Below it is the list of threads, with the most recently active first. Each shows its author, how many replies it has and how long ago it was last active.
- **Thread page (`/t/:id`):** the opening post, its replies in order, and a reply form. A "← All threads" link goes back home, and a bad or unknown thread link shows a "doesn't exist" message.
- Threads and replies are saved in the deployment's store, so they're still there after a reload. Empty posts are rejected with an inline message, and clicking submit twice won't post twice.

**Checks:** the code compiled cleanly, and both tests pass: one for the time and count wording ("2h ago", "1 reply"), and one that rejects a thread without a title. I also ran the submit logic directly and it does the right thing. I haven't loaded the page in a browser, though, so posting a thread and a reply for real is still unchecked.

**Limits:** there are no accounts, so anyone can post under any name. There's also no editing, deleting or moderation, and no pagination; the store returns at most 10,000 rows per list.

The code is in `Forum.*` (the home page app and the stored `Forum.Topic` / `Forum.Reply` records) and `Forum.Thread.*` (the thread page). Page addresses are set in `Forum.Routes`.
